leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a brute force solution to find two numbers that sum to a target
Construct a hash map to store numbers and their indices for efficient lookup
Manipulate array indices to return the correct pair of indices for the two sum
Apply the optimized solution to reduce time complexity from O(n²) to O(n)
Initialize and update a hash map while iterating through the input array
Integrate the two sum algorithm into a function that accepts an array and target
Control loop iterations to check for complement values in the hash map
